workflows.title: Capture printer baseline
workflows.summary: Read the live Klipper configuration and save an as-built snapshot for the final manual.

steps.title: Confirm connection
steps.instructions: Klipper must report Ready. No machine movement is performed.

steps.title: Capture configuration
steps.instructions: Save the current Klipper configuration and relevant live status to the calibration record.

steps.title: Add baseline notes
steps.instructions: Record recent repairs, modifications, or known issues.

workflows.title: Toolhead sensors and first extrusion
workflows.summary: Baby-step filament, watch live sensor states, and mark entry, toolhead, and first-steady-extrusion positions.
workflows.safety: Only run while the printer is idle. Heat the nozzle before pushing filament through the nozzle. Keep hands clear of gears and the cutter.

steps.title: Prepare the toolhead
steps.instructions: Start with the correct gate selected. For physical geometry, use a clean/cold-pulled toolhead. Lock the tension/compression mechanism during Happy Hare geometry measurements.

steps.title: Mark extruder-entry sensor
steps.instructions: Advance slowly until the entry sensor changes state, then mark the position.

steps.title: Mark post-extruder toolhead sensor
steps.instructions: Continue through the extruder gears until the toolhead sensor changes state, then mark the position.

steps.title: Mark first steady extrusion
steps.instructions: Heat for the selected filament. Advance in small steps and mark the first continuous strand—not the first drool.

steps.title: Repeat and compare
steps.instructions: Run the measurement at least three times. The report will show the average and spread.

steps.title: Review results
steps.instructions: Compare measured values with current Happy Hare settings. This release records recommendations but does not edit configuration files.

workflows.title: Directional purge-volume samples
workflows.summary: Record outgoing/incoming filament pairs and the first visually clean stepped purge sample.

steps.title: Choose transition
steps.instructions: Select outgoing and incoming filament profiles.

steps.title: Produce stepped samples
steps.instructions: A later release will generate numbered purge tiles or strips.

steps.title: Select first clean sample
steps.instructions: Choose the first clean sample and apply a safety margin.
